items.name: Empty Lantern
items.description: A tin lantern with a cracked glass pane. Its reservoir is bone dry.

items.name: Flask of Lamp Oil
items.description: A small stoppered flask of amber oil.

items.name: Lit Lantern
items.description: The lantern burns with a steady golden flame. Dark places hold no secrets from you now.

items.name: Heel of Bread
items.description: Stale, but it would do in a pinch.

items.name: Brass Key
items.description: A heavy brass key with a book engraved on its bow.

items.name: Tower Key
items.description: A long iron key, cold to the touch, with a tiny bell etched into it.

items.name: Torn Map
items.description: Half a map of the keep. Someone has scrawled a note in the margin.
items.hint: The slab beneath the hall opens only when the bell wakes the keep at the turning of the night.

items.name: Iron Anvil
items.description: A blacksmith's anvil. It must weigh as much as a pony.

items.name: Bell Rope
items.description: A thick, frayed rope that disappears up into the bell.

items.name: Ember Crown
items.description: A crown of blackened gold that glows from within. Legends say whoever holds it is master of Lantern Keep.
